title: Constrained PSLQ Search for Machin-like Identities Achieving Record-Low Lehmer Measures
abstract: arXiv:2508.08307v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machin-like arctangent relations are classical tools for computing $\pi$, with efficiency quantified by the Lehmer measure ($\lambda$). We present a framework for discovering low-measure relations by coupling the PSLQ integer-relation algorithm with number-theoretic filters derived from the algebraic structure of Gaussian integers, making large scale search tractable. Our search yields new 5 and 6 term relations with record-low Lehmer measures ($\lambda=1.4572, \lambda=1.3291$). We also demonstrate how discovered relations can serve as a basis for generating new, longer formulae through algorithmic extensions. This combined approach of a constrained PSLQ search and algorithmic extension provides a robust method for future explorations.

translated_title: 基于约束PSLQ搜索实现创纪录低Lehmer测度的类Machin恒等式
translated_abstract: 类Machin反正切关系是计算π的经典工具，其效率由Lehmer测度（λ）来量化。我们提出了一个发现低测度关系的框架，该框架将PSLQ整数关系算法与源自高斯整数代数结构的数论过滤器相结合，使大规模搜索变得可行。我们的搜索得到了新的5项和6项关系，其Lehmer测度创历史新低（λ=1.4572, λ=1.3291）。我们还展示了如何通过算法扩展，将所发现的关系作为生成新的更长公式的基础。这种约束PSLQ搜索与算法扩展相结合的方法，为未来的探索提供了一种稳健的途径。
tldr: 本文提出将PSLQ整数关系算法与基于高斯整数代数结构的数论过滤器相结合的约束搜索框架，成功发现了Lehmer测度创纪录新低（λ=1.3291）的5项和6项类Machin恒等式，并可通过算法扩展生成更长的公式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a constrained PSLQ search framework that couples the integer-relation algorithm with number-theoretic filters derived from Gaussian integers, discovering new 5- and 6-term Machin-like identities with record-low Lehmer measures (λ=1.3291) and enabling algorithmic extension to longer formulae.
